title: Submit a new civic issue with guidance
description: A citizen can report a new issue with a photo, location, description, and category guidance, then receive tracking details for the created report.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen/report
Upload a photo for the report
Allow approximate location access
Fill in a description of the issue
Review the category suggestion
Accept the suggested category
Submit the report
Verify the issue confirmation is visible
Verify tracking details for the created issue are visible

title: Move an issue through triage to a claimed resolution
description: A mock officer can open an issue from the queue, change its status through the workflow, and claim it as resolved with proof attached.

steps.description: Navigate to /officer/queue
Open an issue from the triage queue
Assign the issue
Move the issue to in-progress
Add proof of fix notes or evidence
Mark the issue as claimed resolved
Verify the issue shows the updated workflow state
Verify the proof-related update is visible

title: Submit a verification vote for a claimed fix
description: A citizen can review the before-and-after evidence for a claimed fix and submit a verification vote that is recorded on the issue timeline.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen/issue/1/verify
Review the before-and-after evidence for the issue
Select fixed as the verification vote
Submit the verification vote
Verify the verification vote is recorded
Verify the issue timeline reflects the updated verification activity

title: Review a reported issue timeline and current status
description: A citizen can open a reported issue and inspect its lifecycle timeline, current status, and supporting activity.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen
Open one of the user's reported issues
Verify the issue details page is visible
Verify the status timeline and supporting activity are displayed

title: Assign and advance an issue through the officer workflow
description: A mock officer can open an issue from the queue, assign it, move it to in progress, and claim it resolved with proof of work.

steps.description: Navigate to /officer/queue
Open an issue from the triage queue
Assign the issue to the current officer
Update the issue status to in progress
Mark the issue as claimed resolved
Verify the issue shows the claimed resolved state
Verify the timeline reflects the officer progress

title: Verify a claimed fix from the issue timeline
description: A citizen can review before-and-after evidence on a claimed fix and submit a verification vote from the issue timeline.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen
Open one of the user's reported issues
Open the verification view for the claimed fix
Review the before-and-after evidence
Vote that the issue is fixed
Verify the verification result is recorded
Verify the issue reflects the updated verification state

title: Support a nearby duplicate issue from the citizen dashboard
description: A citizen can find a matching nearby issue and support it instead of creating a duplicate, increasing the shared support count.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen
Open the nearby issues view
Choose a nearby issue that matches the same problem
Support the issue
Verify the support count increases
Verify the issue remains available as a shared report

title: Record that a claimed fix is not yet resolved
description: A citizen can review the evidence for a claimed fix and submit a not fixed vote that is reflected in the issue's verification state.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen/issue/1/verify
Review the before-and-after evidence for the issue
Select not fixed as the verification vote
Submit the verification vote
Verify the not fixed vote is recorded
Verify the issue shows that the fix is still disputed

title: Correct the suggested category before submitting a report
description: A citizen can override the suggested category during issue submission and the created issue reflects the chosen category.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen/report
Upload a photo for the report
Allow approximate location access
Fill in a description of the issue
Review the category suggestion
Select a different category
Submit the report
Verify the created issue is visible
Verify the selected category is reflected on the created issue

title: Attach proof of work while resolving an issue
description: A mock officer can add a note and proof photo during issue resolution and see the proof recorded in the issue history.

steps.description: Navigate to /officer/issue/1
Review the issue details and similar issues
Assign the issue to the current officer
Update the issue status to in progress
Add a resolution note
Attach proof of work
Verify the proof of work is recorded
Verify the issue history includes the new officer update

title: Support an existing nearby issue during report creation
description: A citizen can switch from creating a duplicate report to supporting an existing nearby issue and see that support recorded in their activity.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen/report
Upload a photo for the report
Allow approximate location access
Fill in a description of the issue
Review nearby duplicate suggestions
Choose to support an existing nearby issue
Confirm the support action
Verify the selected issue is added to the user's supported items
Verify the duplicate report is not created

title: Show a validation error when report details are incomplete
description: A citizen cannot submit an issue report without the required description and sees a validation error instead of creating the report.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen/report
Upload a photo for the report
Allow approximate location access
Submit the report
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the issue was not created

title: Let a public visitor inspect the transparency map and filters
description: A public visitor can open the transparency portal, review the map, and use filters to narrow visible civic issues.
category: Review Public Transparency Map and Scorecards

steps.description: Navigate to /transparency
Review the public issue map
Apply a ward, category, or status filter
Verify the map updates to reflect the selected filter
Verify matching public issue markers are displayed

title: Review public issue details with privacy redaction
description: A public visitor can open a transparency issue page and see redacted issue information with public evidence preserved.

steps.description: Navigate to /transparency
Open a public issue from the map or list
Verify the redacted issue details page is visible
Verify public evidence or status information is displayed

title: Open a redacted public issue and review its timeline
description: A public visitor can open a public issue detail page and see redacted information, a public timeline, and media that preserves privacy.
category: Review Public Transparency Map and Scorecards

steps.description: Navigate to /transparency
Open a public issue from the map or list
Verify the issue detail page shows redacted public information
Verify the public timeline and redacted media are displayed

title: Submit an unsure verification vote
description: A citizen can mark a claimed fix as unsure when the evidence is not conclusive and the issue still reflects a pending community verdict.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen
Open one of the user's reported issues
Open the verification view for the claimed fix
Vote that the result is unsure
Verify the unsure verification is recorded
Verify the issue remains in a review state

title: Record uncertainty when verifying a claimed fix
description: A citizen can review the evidence for a claimed fix and submit an unsure vote without asserting that the issue is fixed or broken.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen/issue/1/verify
Review the before-and-after evidence for the issue
Select unsure as the verification vote
Submit the verification vote
Verify the unsure vote is recorded
Verify no fixed or not fixed verdict is shown

title: Show the triage queue for issues needing action
description: A mock officer can review the triage queue and see issues available for assignment and progress.

steps.description: Navigate to /officer/queue
Review the triage queue
Verify issues needing action are displayed
Verify the queue includes assignable items

title: Browse transparency scorecards and issue metrics
description: A public visitor can inspect the transparency portal and view ward or department scorecards, including SLA and backlog-style metrics.

steps.description: Navigate to /transparency
Open the scorecards or metrics view
Verify scorecard metrics are displayed
Verify SLA or issue-breach information is visible

title: Review ward and department performance snapshots
description: A public visitor can inspect scorecards that summarize ward or department performance, including SLA compliance and resolution timing.
category: Review Public Transparency Map and Scorecards

steps.description: Navigate to /transparency
Open the ward or department scorecards section
Verify performance scorecards are displayed
Verify SLA compliance and median resolution time are shown

title: Inspect SLA breaches and forgotten issues
description: A public visitor can review the breach wall and open older neglected issues to understand the most overdue public items.
category: Review Public Transparency Map and Scorecards

steps.description: Navigate to /transparency
Open the SLA breach wall or forgotten issues section
Verify overdue public issues are displayed
Verify the oldest or most neglected items are visible

title: Prevent self-supporting the same issue
description: A citizen cannot support their own issue report and sees a prevention message or disabled action instead.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen/report
Upload a photo for the report
Allow approximate location access
Fill in a description of the issue
Submit the report
Open the created issue
Attempt to support the same issue from the nearby support flow
Verify self-support is prevented
Verify the support count does not change

title: Prevent claiming resolution without progressing the issue
description: A mock officer sees that an issue cannot be claimed resolved until it has been moved through the required workflow.

steps.description: Navigate to /officer/issue/1
Review the issue details
Attempt to mark the issue as claimed resolved before progressing it
Verify a workflow validation error is visible
Verify the issue is not marked as claimed resolved

title: Show validation when verifying without selecting a vote
description: A citizen sees a validation error when trying to submit a verification vote without choosing an option.

steps.description: Navigate to /citizen/issue/1/verify
Review the before-and-after evidence for the issue
Submit the verification vote without selecting an option
Verify a vote validation error is visible
Verify the vote is not recorded
